verdict.rationale: Chroma Cloud is clearly documented as a fully managed, serverless offering, with a BYOC option and the same '0-ops' story (docs-9, docs-15, docs-28), and paying community users corroborate it (comm-4, comm-5, comm-2). Programmatic provisioning is only implied: the CLI can 'interact with your Chroma Cloud DBs' and a DB can be created in 30 seconds, but nothing explicitly documents creating or provisioning databases via API or CLI. missing for 10: explicit documentation of programmatic DB/tenant provisioning (API endpoints or CLI create commands), hands-on corroboration of automated provisioning.
